title: Maximum Value of a String
statement: Treat digit-only strings as integers and other strings by length.
approach_name: Compare numeric values and nonnumeric string lengths

title: Maximum Value of a String
statement: Treat digit-only strings as integers and other strings by length.
approach_name: Compare numeric values and nonnumeric string lengths
code:
import java.util.*;
class Solution { public int maximumValue(String[] strs){int best=0;for(String s:strs){boolean numeric=true;for(char c:s.toCharArray())if(!Character.isDigit(c)){numeric=false;break;}best=Math.max(best,numeric?Integer.parseInt(s):s.length());}return best;} }

title: Delete Greatest Value in Each Row
statement: Sort rows and sum the maximum remaining value at each column.
approach_name: Sort each row and sum column maxima
code:
import java.util.*;
class Solution { public int deleteGreatestValue(int[][] grid){for(int[] r:grid)Arrays.sort(r);int ans=0;for(int j=0;j<grid[0].length;j++){int m=0;for(int[] r:grid)m=Math.max(m,r[j]);ans+=m;}return ans;} }

title: Count Pairs Of Similar Strings
statement: Count pairs whose words have the same set of letters.
approach_name: Count pairs with identical sets of letters
code:
import java.util.*;
class Solution { public int similarPairs(String[] words){int n=words.length,c=0;Set<Character>[] sets=new Set[n];for(int i=0;i<n;i++){sets[i]=new HashSet<>();for(char x:words[i].toCharArray())sets[i].add(x);}for(int i=0;i<n;i++)for(int j=i+1;j<n;j++)if(sets[i].equals(sets[j]))c++;return c;} }

title: Maximum Enemy Forts That Can Be Captured
statement: Count zeros between consecutive opposite nonzero forts.
approach_name: Count zeros between opposite nonzero forts

title: Maximum Enemy Forts That Can Be Captured
statement: Count zeros between consecutive opposite nonzero forts.
approach_name: Count zeros between opposite nonzero forts
code:
import java.util.*;
class Solution { public int captureForts(int[] forts){int best=0,prev=-1;for(int i=0;i<forts.length;i++)if(forts[i]!=0){if(prev>=0&&forts[i]==-forts[prev])best=Math.max(best,i-prev-1);prev=i;}return best;} }

title: Count the Digits That Divide a Number

title: Count the Digits That Divide a Number
statement: Check each digit as a divisor.
approach_name: Count digits that divide the original number
code:
import java.util.*;
class Solution { public int countDigits(int num){int c=0;for(char ch:String.valueOf(num).toCharArray()){int d=ch-'0';if(num%d==0)c++;}return c;} }

title: Maximum Count of Positive Integer and Negative Integer

title: Maximum Count of Positive Integer and Negative Integer
statement: Count negative and positive elements and take the larger count.
approach_name: Count positive and negative elements
code:
import java.util.*;
class Solution { public int maximumCount(int[] nums){int neg=0,pos=0;for(int x:nums)if(x<0)neg++;else if(x>0)pos++;return Math.max(neg,pos);} }

title: Difference Between Element Sum and Digit Sum of an Array
statement: Subtract the total digit sum from the element sum.
approach_name: Compare element sum with digit sum
code:
import java.util.*;
class Solution { public int differenceOfSum(int[] nums){int a=0,b=0;for(int x:nums){a+=x;while(x>0){b+=x%10;x/=10;}}return Math.abs(a-b);} }

title: Minimum Common Value
statement: Find the first shared value in sorted arrays.
approach_name: Find the first common value with two pointers
code:
import java.util.*;
class Solution { public int getCommon(int[] nums1,int[] nums2){int i=0,j=0;while(i<nums1.length&&j<nums2.length){if(nums1[i]==nums2[j])return nums1[i];if(nums1[i]<nums2[j])i++;else j++;}return -1;} }

title: Alternating Digit Sum
statement: Add and subtract digits alternately from left to right.
approach_name: Alternate addition and subtraction of digits
code:
import java.util.*;
class Solution { public int alternateDigitSum(int n){String s=String.valueOf(n);int sum=0;for(int i=0;i<s.length();i++)sum+=(i%2==0?1:-1)*(s.charAt(i)-'0');return sum;} }

title: Separate the Digits in an Array
statement: Append each number's digits in original order.
approach_name: Flatten decimal digits preserving order
code:
import java.util.*;
class Solution { public int[] separateDigits(int[] nums){StringBuilder b=new StringBuilder();for(int x:nums)b.append(x);int[] out=new int[b.length()];for(int i=0;i<out.length;i++)out[i]=b.charAt(i)-'0';return out;} }
